youtube_short.title: Bulk Buying Is a $1,800 Trap
title_alternatives: Why Costco Members Spend MORE Money
The Bulk Buying Trap Nobody Talks About
youtube_short.description: You haul those giant packs home thinking you're saving money — but Wharton researchers proved bulk buyers actually spend $1,800 more every year. Full pantry means you consume 30% faster. Bulk households waste 40% more food. Add the membership fee and in-store impulse buys, and the math doesn't add up. The fix isn't quitting bulk entirely — just buy non-perishables only and always use a list. #personalfinance #money #savingmoney #budgeting #costco

hook_line: Bulk buying costs you $1,800 more every year
